latin: Attributales perfectiones nec in deo, nec secundum se quiditatiue sumptae, dicunt diuersas rationes in recto, et principaliter diffinibiles uel descriptibiles.
translation: The attributal perfections, whether taken in God or taken quidditatively on their own, do not properly amount to distinct concepts, above all ones open to definition or description.
translation_note: Parallels the claim about the three transcendentals in 4>7.
